[[File:Drake chathead.png|left|60px]]
'''Drakes''' are male [[duck]]s that can be found on land near other ducks. They do not swim in the water, but instead wander near the ponds. They may be fed by using [[breadcrumbs]] or [[duck food]] on them. If one is fed over 21 breadcrumbs or duck food in 20 seconds, it will be turned into [[Mega Duck]].  

You can not feed a drake if you are standing next to it; at least one tile of space between the player and the drake is required, which can also be achieved by standing directly diagonally to it.
